full_prompt_en: A square, dramatic painted scene looks past two onlookers on a dark balcony toward a large ship ablaze in a night harbor. At the lower left, a woman in a pale blue-green dress leans over the carved railing with both hands, her dark hair bound by a narrow gold band. Behind her stands a man in a dark garment with bright gold shoulder trim. Both are seen from the back or side and look across the water. The ship occupies the right middle distance, its long dark hull tilted diagonally across the image. Bright white-yellow fire races along its upper edge, and enormous orange clouds of flame and smoke billow upward into the black sky. On the left, blue-green smoke and haze create a cooler wall behind the figures. The harbor water catches broken turquoise, orange, and white reflections; several tiny boats and figures lie near the burning vessel, reduced to dark strokes against the glare. The balcony rail curves along the bottom and right edge, framing the vantage point. Thick, energetic brushwork builds the smoke and flame, while smaller, more controlled strokes describe clothing trim, the hull, and ripples. Fire supplies the dominant light, illuminating the onlookers' profiles and the woman's pale skirt from the right, while their backs and the foreground rail remain shadowed. The color contrast between teal night and molten orange gives the scene its force. A diagonal hull, surging smoke, and clustered miniature boats make the middle distance chaotic, countered by the still figures in the foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形戏剧性绘画越过深色阳台上的两名观者，望向夜港里燃烧的大船。左下，一位穿浅蓝绿色长裙的女子双手扶着雕饰栏杆前倾，深发由一条窄金带束住。她后面站着一位衣着深色、肩部有亮金饰边的男子。两人从背侧可见，都望向水面。大船占据右侧中景，长而深色的船体斜穿画面。亮白黄色火焰沿船上缘蔓延，巨大的橘色火云和浓烟向上翻进黑天空。左侧蓝绿色烟雾与迷蒙空气在人物背后形成较冷的色墙。港水接住碎裂的青蓝、橘色和白色倒影；燃烧船只附近有几艘极小舟与人影，在炫光前被压成深色笔痕。阳台栏杆沿底部和右缘弯过，圈出观望位置。厚重活跃的笔触塑造烟与火，较小、较受控的笔画描述衣饰、船体和水纹。火是主光源，从右侧照亮观者侧脸及女子浅裙，而背面和前景栏杆仍在阴影里。青蓝夜色与熔橘色的对照提供场景力量。斜向船体、翻涌烟云与成簇微小舟船使中景混乱，与前景静止人影相抵。
style_prompt_en: A cinematic painted surface opposes deep teal-blue darkness to a concentrated mass of incandescent orange, gold, and near-white. Thick irregular strokes and turbulent rounded edges build the brightest area; cool smoky scumbles spread into the opposite side. The lower middle is broken into short horizontal marks that repeat both warm and cool light as reflection. Dark near-silhouettes in the foreground anchor the composition, their edges rimmed selectively by the strong off-center glow. A broad diagonal form leads into the fiery focal cluster, while tiny marks around it establish scale and agitation. Shadows remain deep and textured, not flat. The scene gains depth from backlighting, overlap, and the contrast of still foreground shapes with vigorous middle-distance brushwork. High local contrast and rough paint texture create an urgent, theatrical rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感绘画表面把深青蓝黑暗与集中爆发的炽橘、金色和近白色相对。厚重不规则笔触与翻滚的圆边构成最亮区域；冷色烟雾擦涂扩散到另一侧。下部中景被短水平笔痕切碎，重复暖冷两类光的倒映。前景深色近剪影固定构图，边缘只在强烈偏侧光照处被勾亮。宽阔斜向形体导向火光焦点簇，周围微小笔点建立尺度和躁动。阴影保持深厚且有纹理，不是平黑。画面依靠逆光、遮叠，以及静止前景形块与活跃中景笔触的对比取得纵深。局部高反差和粗粝颜料肌理形成紧迫、舞台化的节奏。
theme_en: Two onlookers watch a large ship burning in a night harbor
theme_zh: 两名观者凝望夜港中燃烧的大船
name: Cecil B. DeMille
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
